# OfficeQA Skill

## Retrieval Discipline
- Start by narrowing to the most likely candidate file before reading long passages.
- Prefer targeted search terms that name the exact entity, period, measure, or table concept from the question.
- After a promising match, read only a small surrounding span and verify it matches the requested year, basis, and unit.

## Evidence Discipline
- Extract the exact value from the retrieved text before doing any arithmetic.
- Keep track of each operand's period, unit, and semantic role so nearby proxy values are not mixed in.
- Preserve the sign through every step: when the answer is a difference, "change," or net figure, report it as the signed number the question asks for (a decrease is negative) rather than dropping the sign or restating a decline as a positive magnitude.
- If the question asks for a transformed or derived quantity, compute only after confirming every operand.
- If a read returns only headings, table-of-contents entries, section labels, footnotes, or annual aggregates instead of the specific numeric data rows for the requested periods, the operands are not yet extracted: keep targeting (grep the exact row label, read the continuation page, or switch to the monthly/annual sub-series) until the actual numbers for every required period are visible, then compute.

## Final Answer Discipline
- Return the final answer only after one last consistency check against the retrieved evidence.
- Copy the final answer from a checked value, not from an unverified intermediate guess.
- Emit the requested quantity in a single form: do not append a parenthetical restatement, an alternate-unit or alternate-percent version, or explanatory notes after the number (e.g., "0.045 (about 4.5% rate)"). Include only the unit the question itself asks for; extra trailing text becomes extra tokens that break exact match.

attempts.approach: Added a Final Answer Discipline bullet requiring the requested quantity be emitted in a single form: no parenthetical restatement, alternate-unit/percent version, or explanatory notes, and only the unit the question asks for.

appended-alternate-answer-restatement.description: Agent appends an unrequested alternate/parenthetical representation (a percent restatement) after the single requested numeric value, adding extra tokens that break exact match.
appended-alternate-answer-restatement.evidence: Trajectory [3] (UID0239): question asked for a rounded three-decimal continuous growth rate; agent emitted "0.045 (about 4.495% continuous rate)", appending an alternate-percent restatement so the answer scored partial (F1~0.08) despite the correct underlying operand value 0.045.
appended-alternate-answer-restatement.label: appended-alternate-answer-restatement

attempts.approach: Added an Evidence Discipline bullet making operand confirmation concrete: if reads return only headings/TOC/section labels/footnotes/annual aggregates rather than the specific numeric data rows for the requested periods, the operands are not yet extracted — keep targeting until the actual numbers for every required period are visible, then compute.

decisive-table-values-not-isolated.description: Agent locates the correct table but does not isolate/enumerate the actual numeric data rows for every required period before computing or answering.

violations: Trajectory [2] (UID0027): located Table AY-1 but grep'd for a single November row and treated it as Nov 1969 without extracting/enumerating all 1960–1969 monthly rows to find the maximum spread, despite the Evidence Discipline entry requiring every required period's numbers be visible before computing.

Trajectory [4] (UID0041): read only the table header and one late mixed-agency row, never assembling the FY1961–1970 REA series before computing the Theil index, violating the entry's requirement to keep targeting until actual numeric rows for every period are visible.
Trajectory [6] (UID0070): extracted only Aug–Oct 1939 'cases closed' values yet reported a 12-month total of 182, never isolating Nov–Dec 1938 or Jan–Jul 1939 data rows.

decisive-table-values-not-isolated.evidence: Trajectory [2] (UID0027): found Table AY-1 but grep'd year strings and a single November row, treating it as Nov 1969 without comparing all 1960–1969 monthly rows for the max spread; Trajectory [4] (UID0041): read the table header and one late mixed-agency row, never assembling the FY1961–1970 REA annual series before computing the Theil index.
decisive-table-values-not-isolated.examples_state_evidence: The iter_4 Evidence Discipline bullet ("If a read returns only headings, table-of-contents entries, section labels, footnotes, or annual aggregates ... keep targeting ... until the actual numbers for every required period are visible, then compute") is abstract prose only; it has no attached concrete (correct, incorrect) example pairs.
decisive-table-values-not-isolated.label: decisive-table-values-not-isolated

attempts.approach: Added an Error Avoidance rule to confirm row/column granularity and role (monthly vs annual, fiscal vs calendar, Aaa vs Aa, tenders received vs accepted) before extracting.

granularity-role-confusion.description: Agent confuses the semantic role/scope of the source line when extracting operands — using a summary row or a current-period narrative sentence instead of the exact series/table/revision the question names.
granularity-role-confusion.evidence: Traj 9 (UID0073): agent extracted the summary "Net budget outlays" line rather than verifying it matched the requested per-function outlay series, computing the std dev on the wrong operand set. Traj 8 (UID0065): agent used narrative current-quarter productivity figures (2.0%, 0.2%) instead of the "as published in the subsequent quarter" revision the question specified.
granularity-role-confusion.label: granularity-role-confusion
granularity-role-confusion.resolve_evidence: Trajectory [6] (UID0101) correctly distinguished "this fiscal year" vs "prior fiscal year" columns, pulling FY2011 from the Dec-2012 prior-year column and FY2019 from Dec-2019. Trajectory [5] (UID0098) correctly selected the "Total 10+11−12" borrowing series over adjacent rows. Role/granularity discrimination was done correctly despite similar-looking neighbor values.

attempts.approach: Rewrote the first Retrieval Discipline bullet to require enumerating/globbing the corpus by year/issue to obtain real filenames first, noting guessed paths fail with path-not-allowed and unconfirmed-file searches return nothing, so the agent never opens with a wasted guessed-path search.

guessed-file-path-searches-fail-wasting-.description: Agent opens with grep/search calls on guessed bulletin paths that fail with "path not allowed" then "no matches," burning turns before locating a real filename.
guessed-file-path-searches-fail-wasting-.evidence: Trajectory [3] (UID0239): initial grep-style searches failed with path-not-allowed before it eventually located the Jan 1952/Jan 1953 bulletins; Trajectory [4] (UID0240): two grep calls rejected as path-not-allowed, then two more searches returned "no matches," consuming turns before any content was read.
guessed-file-path-searches-fail-wasting-.label: guessed-file-path-searches-fail-wasting-turns

attempts.approach: Added Workflow step 3 requiring the agent to list every required period, count them, and confirm each has an extracted value before starting any aggregate arithmetic.

incomplete-observation-set-before-aggreg.description: Agent reports a total count of qualifying months across two ownership surveys without grounding/enumerating each month's value against the retrieved table rows, producing a wrong count.
incomplete-observation-set-before-aggreg.evidence: Trajectory [2] (UID0154): reported 12 qualifying months (6 from the Jan-1977 survey span + 6 from the Jan-1978 span) but the baseline gate scored EM=0, F1=0.5 (a same-skill candidate rerun reached EM=1), indicating the enumerated qualifying-month set does not match gold; the trace shows no visible tool calls retrieving the Table TSO-3 rows to substantiate the per-month thresholds.
incomplete-observation-set-before-aggreg.label: incomplete-observation-set-before-aggregation

attempts.approach: Added Workflow step 2 guidance and an Error Avoidance rule to navigate to and read the page named by an index/TOC/figure reference instead of re-searching the index.

index-page-reference-not-followed.description: After an index/TOC/figure reference names a specific page or chart, the agent keeps re-searching the index or samples unrelated text instead of navigating to and reading that page.
index-page-reference-not-followed.evidence: Trajectory [10] (UID0031): grep found the exact index entry 'TF-G ... page 148', but the agent repeatedly re-grepped the index/headings and read adjacent trust-fund tables rather than reading page 148, producing no supported answer. Trajectory [9] (UID0030): never isolated page 5, repeatedly sampled unrelated economic-policy text, then returned an unsupported '24'.
index-page-reference-not-followed.label: index-page-reference-not-followed
index-page-reference-not-followed.resolve_evidence: Traj 4 (UID0046): the agent searched the table of contents, identified the chart "Gross Federal obligations ... incurred outside the Federal Government" at page 21, then navigated to and read the FO-1 table for March 31, 1988 and computed the 69% answer. It followed the TOC/figure page reference to the actual table instead of re-searching the index or sampling unrelated text.

multi-attribute-row-mismatch.description: When a target instrument is identified by multiple attributes (coupon AND maturity, entity AND line item), the agent substitutes a nearby row satisfying only some attributes instead of confirming every attribute matches.
multi-attribute-row-mismatch.evidence: Trajectory [5] (UID0150): asked for the 3.5% Treasury bond maturing February 1990; agent settled on a 3-1/2% bond maturing 1980 (wrong maturity) and a 6-1/8% bond bid 91.04 maturing 1990 (wrong coupon) in Table MQ-3, so no valid year-end bid operands were extracted and the forecast was unsupported.
multi-attribute-row-mismatch.label: multi-attribute-row-mismatch

attempts.approach: Added an Evidence Discipline bullet requiring the sign of a difference/change/net figure to be preserved and reported as the signed number the question asks for (a decrease is negative), never dropping the sign or restating a decline as a positive magnitude.

sign-dropped-in-difference-answer.description: Agent computes the correct signed difference/change but drops the negative sign and restates a decline as a positive magnitude in the final answer.
sign-dropped-in-difference-answer.evidence: Trajectory [2] (UID0085): computed California share change CY2018→CY2019 ≈ −0.068 pp but reported "0.068 percentage points", dropping the sign (baseline EM=0, F1=0.5); the accepted sign-preservation patch flipped this case to EM=1/F1=1 in the candidate.
sign-dropped-in-difference-answer.label: sign-dropped-in-difference-answer
sign-dropped-in-difference-answer.resolve_evidence: Trajectory [8] (UID0163): asked for the change in the Fed banks' operating balance from Oct 1981 to Nov 1981; the agent returned -75, preserving the negative sign for the decline and matching gold (EM=1). The scenario (a decline in a change figure) is triggered and handled with correct sign — no restatement as a positive magnitude.

attempts.approach: Same patch prevents the path-not-allowed/no-match failures up front by having the agent enumerate real filenames before searching, removing the trigger that led agents to abandon retrieval and answer from memory.

tool-failure-not-recovered-answer-from-m.description: After path-not-allowed/no-match search and read failures, the agent abandons retrieval and answers from memory with unverified operands instead of locating the table.
tool-failure-not-recovered-answer-from-m.evidence: Trajectory [4] (UID0240): every tool call errored or matched nothing, yet the agent asserted unverified operating balances of 4,187 (FY1953) and 6,207 (FY1954) and output a degenerate duration of 1.0000 without ever retrieving any Treasury Bulletin row.
tool-failure-not-recovered-answer-from-m.label: tool-failure-not-recovered-answer-from-memory

unit-word-appended-to-scaled-answer.description: Agent appends a scale/unit word (e.g., "thousand", "million") to an answer whose scale the question already specifies, introducing non-normalized tokens that break exact match.
unit-word-appended-to-scaled-answer.evidence: Traj 7 (UID0063): correctly used the middle net-change column and computed 86,000 − 81,774 = 4,226, but answered "4,226 (thousand U.S. dollars)"; normalization strips "dollars" but not "thousand", so the answer was graded partial rather than exact.
unit-word-appended-to-scaled-answer.label: unit-word-appended-to-scaled-answer

wrong-measure-percent-vs-dollar-differen.description: Agent answers a difference question by computing a symmetric percent-difference and reporting a percentage instead of the plain absolute difference in the unit (millions of dollars) the question asks for.
wrong-measure-percent-vs-dollar-differen.evidence: Trajectory [9] (UID0220): extracted Feb 1938=528 and Jan 1939=693, then applied |693-528|/((693+528)/2)*100 and reported "27.0%" rather than the absolute difference in millions (~165); gate EM=0, F1=0. Also possible operand confusion (Feb 1938 possibly from the general-expenditures table rather than total column).
wrong-measure-percent-vs-dollar-differen.label: wrong-measure-percent-vs-dollar-difference
